channel.title: Wayne Grudem - Systematic Theology (Complete Audio Series)
channel.description: Personal-use RSS wrapper for the publicly hosted Wayne Grudem Systematic Theology audio archive. Audio remains hosted by WayneGrudem.com. The source page lists 119 lecture entries; this feed contains 114 unique playable MP3 files, omitting two entries with no audio and combining entries that share the same MP3.
channel.itunes:author: Wayne Grudem
channel.itunes:summary: Wayne Grudem Systematic Theology lectures, arranged as a serialized course for sequential listening.
